title: Materialize the mandatory FA3 current-host model artifact security runtime
decision: Materialize the P0 Model Artifact Security profile as a local-first, fail-closed current-host runtime bound to the Model Manager. Use a Python 3.10-3.12 sidecar venv rather than Ubuntu system Python 3.14 where upstream scanners do not support it. Separate bootstrap/update network activity from scan execution; every scan runs in a bubblewrap network namespace with HOME and /run masked, telemetry disabled, and the quarantined model read-only. Production evidence requires a real existing local safetensors or GGUF artifact. Synthetic fixtures are permitted only for negative regression and can never promote runtime status.
